title: ID0434484-DC/Si-D/IL-[MP / PN 170001151] DC2 CP voltage doesn't change
description:
Reported behavior/issue: DC2 voltage doesn't change from 12V to 9V when EV is plugged in
Solution: Replace CCS cable
yyyy-mm-dd:
2025-06-30
Measurements on site show that the CP voltage on DC2 does not change from 12V to 9V when the EV is connected.
The same is not seen in DC1, we have a EV plugged and can see 9V.
The measurement was done in XD14:3A->XD14:1A in order to prove that the problem comes directly from the cable and from that point onwards can only be checked afterwards (highly unlikely)

additional_info.subject: Malfunction Report – Sicharge Charging Station | Connector CCS2 #2 | Serial No. 170001151 | Location: Peres Rehovot
additional_info.body:
Dear Siemens Support,
My name is Ahmad, a service technician at Zen Energy, and I would like to report a recurring malfunction at a Sicharge charging station located at Peres Rehovot, with serial number 170001151.
Issue Summary:
•     The issue occurred on 30/06/2025, between 17:00–18:00 (Israel local time).
•     Faulty connector: CCS2 – port number 2.
•     Multiple charging attempts were made:
•     Using the official mobile app.
•     Using an RFID card.
•     After initiating the charging session, the station displays the message: “Connect the cable to your vehicle.”
•     When connecting the cable to the vehicle, the screen does not proceed to the authentication stage, and remains stuck on the same message.
•     In an attempt to resolve the issue, I replaced the following three components (model Phoenix Contact SCK-M-U-1500V):
•     TF1
•     TF2
•     TF5
•     The malfunction persisted even after replacing these components.
•     As a precaution, I have disabled the faulty connector until further inspection and instructions from your side.
I would appreciate your support in checking the station logs for the specified time and providing guidance on how to proceed with the repair.
Best regards,
Ahmed Haim
Electrician
*5619
|
ahmedh@zen-ev.com
